features.name: donation_frequency_rate
features.description: Calculates the average number of donations per month of tenure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps tree models split on the density of donations over the donor's known history.

features.name: active_tenure_months
features.description: The number of months between the donor's first and last donation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct measure of the donor's active lifespan, which trees can use to distinguish long-term committed donors from one-time or short-term donors.

features.name: average_months_between_donations
features.description: The average gap in months between consecutive donations during the donor's active tenure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the typical donation cadence, allowing the model to identify regular vs. sporadic donors.

features.name: is_recent_donor
features.description: Boolean indicator for whether the donor has made a donation within the last 6 months.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a hard split for recent activity, which is often a strong predictor of future behavior in tree models.

features.name: is_frequent_donor
features.description: Boolean indicator for whether the donor has made 5 or more total donations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates a cohort of highly engaged donors, providing a clean categorical split.

features.name: is_long_term_donor
features.description: Boolean indicator for whether the donor's first donation was 36 or more months ago.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the model easily separate established donors from newer acquisitions.

features.name: recent_and_frequent
features.description: Boolean indicator for donors who are both recent (<= 6 months) and frequent (>= 5 donations).
features.expected_model_benefit: Explicitly surfaces a high-value interaction effect that might otherwise require multiple tree splits to isolate.

features.name: months_overdue_for_donation
features.description: The difference between the months since their last donation and their historical average gap between donations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Quantifies how 'overdue' a donor is relative to their own personal cadence, providing a powerful relative behavioral signal.

features.name: single_donor_indicator
features.description: Boolean indicator for donors who have only ever made exactly one donation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates one-time donors, a distinct behavioral cohort that often exhibits different future patterns than repeat donors.

features.name: recency_to_tenure_ratio
features.description: The ratio of months since last donation to months since first donation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes recency against the donor's total history, helping trees identify donors whose inactivity represents a large portion of their tenure.

features.name: donor_loyalty_score
features.description: A semantic evaluation of the donor's overall loyalty and commitment, synthesizing their frequency of donations, total volume donated, and active tenure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, non-linear ranking of donor quality that captures complex interactions between recency, frequency, and monetary value.

features.name: churn_risk_assessment
features.description: An assessment of the likelihood that the donor has permanently lapsed, comparing the recency of their last donation against their historical donation frequency and tenure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates raw temporal gaps into a probabilistic risk score, giving tree models a direct proxy for donor attrition.
